scope: Independent source reasoning at helper-word boundary; not machine-checked proof, compiled/runtime result or benefit.
findings: Reversing only guarded insertion restores original pair bytes exactly; portable body unchanged.
Add bad input selects failure before either zero; bounded a zero selects raw b first, then b zero selects raw a; otherwise original raw OrderedAdd32 result +1.
Multiply either zero selects +0 before invalid other operand; nonzero bad selects failure, bounded nonzero selects original raw OrderedMultiply32 result +1.
Negative operands, four signed-zero pairs, specials, cancellation, ties, underflow to either zero retain selected words. Extra masked arithmetic inputs are finite.
Initial abs-word proposal was rejected in review before compiler/runtime; corrected prototype uses raw words and disjoint zero masks.
countercost: Unconditional finite masked FP work and integer mask ALU; actual driver lowering/material complete-path benefit unproved.
